summary: Three appellants (Manoj, Rahul @ Govind, Neha Verma) convicted under Section 302 IPC (three counts) for murders during robbery of Megha Deshpande, Ashlesha Deshpande, and Smt. Rohini Phadke on 19.06.2011; death penalty confirmed by High Court based on circumstantial evidence including fingerprints, DNA, ballistic reports, recovery of weapons and stolen items; trial and High Court found presence at crime scene, common intention under Section 34 IPC, and recovery evidence reliable; appellants challenged credibility of disclosure statements, arrest procedures, and recovery memos; Supreme Court upheld convictions and death sentences, finding case falls within 'rarest of rare' category due to brutality and societal abhorrence.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; conviction and death sentence upheld.
